# @solutionforest/android-health-connect

> React Native TurboModule for Android Health Connect (API 29+). Android only — no iOS. Requires RN 0.84+ New Architecture.

Package: `@solutionforest/android-health-connect`
Repo: https://github.com/solutionforest/AndroidHealthConnect
Docs site: https://solutionforest.github.io/AndroidHealthConnect/

## Install (both registries)

### npmjs.org (primary)

```
yarn add @solutionforest/android-health-connect
npm install @solutionforest/android-health-connect
```

No `.npmrc` needed. Published via GitHub Actions Trusted Publishing (OIDC).

### GitHub Packages (mirror)

```
# .npmrc
@solutionforest:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=YOUR_GITHUB_PAT
```

```
yarn add @solutionforest/android-health-connect
```

PAT needs `read:packages` (SSO-authorize for `solutionforest` if required). Release `.tgz` + SBOM also on GitHub Releases.

### Lines

- `0.3.x` (default): connect-client `1.2.0-alpha06`, AGP ≥9.1, compileSdk 37, Node ≥22.22
- `0.2.x` / tag `release-0.2`: connect-client `1.1.0` stable, AGP ≥8.9.1, compileSdk 36

## Hard constraints for agents

- Do not invent APIs — use exported functions/types from the package (see `src/index.tsx` / published `.d.ts`).
- Prefer `Permission.*` constants over hand-typed permission strings.
- Health Connect has no push observer; first read/aggregate after resume is often empty/`0` — use `useForegroundPoll`, `pollOnForeground`, or `pollUntil`.
- Feature-gated types need `getFeatureStatus(...) === 'available'` before use.
- Expo: config plugin + `npx expo prebuild`. Bare RN: host manifest permissions + rationale.

## Canonical flows

1. `getHealthConnectAvailability` / `ensureAvailable`
2. `ensurePermissions([Permission.ReadSteps, ...])`
3. `readRecords` / typed helpers (`readSteps`, …) with `timeRangeToday` / `timeRangeLastDays`
4. `writeRecords` / `updateRecords` (`metadata.id` required for update)
5. Aggregates: `aggregateRecord`, `aggregateGroupByDuration`, `aggregateGroupByPeriod`
6. Changelog: `getChangesToken` → `getChanges` / `pullChanges` (~30-day tokens)
7. Matchmaking / PHR when features are available
